statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-24117 is an SSRF in rekor's /api/v1/index/retrieve endpoint, which fetches a public key from a user-supplied URL. The vulnerable code is in rekor's server-side index retrieval handler. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/rekor code directly (rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a rekor transparency log, so the index retrieve endpoint is never served.

CVE-2026-23831 is a nil pointer dereference in rekor's cose v0.0.1 entry Canonicalize() handler when validate() leaves sign1Msg uninitialized for an empty spec.message. The vulnerable code is in rekor's server-side proposed-entry processing. kyverno-reports-server does not import any sigstore/rekor code directly (rekor is an indirect dependency pulled via the opa/cosign chain) and does not run a rekor transparency log, so the cose entry handler is never invoked.
